title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Creating and Backing Up Your Wallet

questions.text: A seed phrase is a master key made of how many random words?
questions.explanation: A seed phrase is a master key made of twelve or twenty-four random words.

questions.text: Storing your seed phrase as a screenshot in your phone notes is safe.
questions.explanation: Anything connected to the internet, including phone notes and screenshots, can be hacked or exposed through cloud backups, so it is not safe.
